title: DemoBot Business Analytics
description: Functional KPI monitoring for Sales, Support and Operations leaders

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) as "value", tipo as "metric" FROM clientes GROUP BY tipo;
SELECT count(*) as "value", a.nombre as "metric" FROM radicados r JOIN areas a ON r.area_id = a.id GROUP BY a.nombre;
SELECT count(*) as "value", estado as "metric" FROM radicados GROUP BY estado;

panels.title: Tiempo Promedio de Espera en Cola

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(duracion_espera_seg), 0) as "value" FROM conversaciones WHERE duracion_espera_seg IS NOT NULL;
SELECT count(*) as "value", COALESCE(motivo_cierre, 'Abierto/Activo') as "metric" FROM conversaciones GROUP BY motivo_cierre;

SELECT r.id as "ID Radicado", r.codigo as "Código", c.nombre as "Contacto", a.nombre as "Área", r.resumen as "Descripción", r.estado as "Estado", r.creado_en as "Fecha" FROM radicados r JOIN contactos c ON r.telefono = c.telefono JOIN areas a ON r.area_id = a.id ORDER BY r.creado_en DESC LIMIT 10;
